text: HARALD PIHL is a family business founded in 1912 and still run by the fourth generation of the Pihl family; ownership remains firmly with the Pihl family, with Carl Pihl and Jonas Pihl as active owners and board members.
short: HARALD PIHL is a family business still owned by the Pihl family.

source.name: Harald Pihl: 'Unsere Geschichte' (haraldpihl.com)
source.quote: Das Eigentum verbleibt fest in der Familie Pihl, wobei Carl Pihl und Jonas Pihl weiterhin als aktive Eigentümer und Vorstandsmitglieder ... verantwortlich sind.
